subject: A schematic neuron in 3D: branching dendrites, the soma, a trigger zone and a myelinated axon ending in terminals.

entities.name: Dendrites
entities.appearance: A branching input tree on one side of the cell body.
entities.quote: Input collects in the branching dendrites and flows into the cell body, the soma.

entities.name: Soma
entities.appearance: The cell body; one membrane voltage stands for the whole neuron.
entities.quote: Soma: The cell body. Its single membrane voltage stands for the whole neuron in this model.

entities.name: Myelin
entities.appearance: Six insulating sheaths around the axon.
entities.quote: six myelin sheaths around the axon

entities.name: Trigger zone
entities.appearance: The axon hillock where the axon begins.
relations: where the axon leaves the soma
entities.quote: Trigger zone: The axon hillock, drawn where the axon begins.

entities.name: Spike pulse
entities.appearance: A pulse that leaves the trigger zone and travels along the axon.
entities.quote: a pulse leaves the trigger zone and travels along the axon

entities.name: Axon
entities.appearance: The output path away from the cell body.
relations: leaves the soma at the trigger zone
entities.quote: Axon: The output path that carries the neuron’s signal away from its cell body.

entities.name: Axon terminals
entities.appearance: The end of the axon where pulses arrive.
relations: at the far end of the axon

entities.name: Leak
entities.appearance: A pull of the voltage back toward rest.
entities.quote: Leak: The tendency for the membrane voltage to move back toward rest.
